message.content: {"title":"Advanced Thermodynamics Planning","category":"categories.science","plans":[{"id":"P36","type":"selection","recordIds":["F6"],"intent":"Given an ideal gas initially at 5 atm and 27 °C in a tire of fixed volume, when the temperature rises to 54 °C, select all statements that correctly describe the final pressure and related quantitative comparisons.","reasoningSteps":["Convert 27 °C and 54 °C to Kelvin (T1=300 K, T2=327 K).","Apply the constant‑volume ideal‑gas relation P1/T1 = P2/T2 to obtain P2 = 5 atm·(327/300) ≈ 5.45 atm.","Compare the computed pressure with each option and evaluate any derived ratios or inequalities."]},{"id":"P37","type":"true_false","recordIds":["F3"],"intent":"Determine the total heat needed to melt 4 kg of ice at 0 °C and then heat the resulting water to 25 °C, then judge the statement “The required heat is 1 694 kJ” as true or false.","reasoningSteps":["Calculate latent heat: Q_latent = m·L_f = 4 kg·3.41×10^5 J/kg = 1.364×10^6 J = 1364 kJ.","Calculate sensible heating: Q_sensible = m·c·ΔT = 4 kg·4180 J/kg·K·25 K = 418 000 J = 418 kJ.","Add the two contributions: Q_total = 1364 kJ + 418 kJ = 1782 kJ and compare with 1694 kJ to decide false."]},{"id":"P38","type":"short_answer","recordIds":["F14"],"intent":"For a refrigeration cycle with coefficient of performance COP = 3 and compressor work input A = 180 kJ, compute the heat rejected to the surroundings (Q₂).","reasoningSteps":["Use COP = Q₁/A to find Q₁ = COP·A = 3·180 kJ = 540 kJ.","Apply the first‑law balance for the cycle: Q₂ = Q₁ + A = 540 kJ + 180 kJ = 720 kJ."]}]}
